title: The Order of the Night Wind revealed
description: After leaving Garsa's Sanctuary, Boba Fett and Fennec Shand discuss Boba's new approach to his position; respect over fear. Just as Fennec advises exactly the opposite, the duo is surrounded and attacked by members of the Order of the Night Wind, an elite group of assassins. The crimson-clad warriors leap through the air from rooftops, dropping and rolling into place. Boba Fett is surrounded!
